limitations: ONE batch-1 pass per occurrence cannot causally attribute the saved native/oracle same-expert text differences: padding/batch compositional (bf16 distributed round-trip), run-order, checkpointing, or cudnn algorithm selection differences may all act on the original training-time and G5 replay evaluations. Text equalities observed at batch-1 are only observations, not causes.

The 21 VQA diagonal and 41 caption final analyses evaluate the same trained banks (shared across two sets); the pair (bank, task, stage) is unique per occurrence and the shared expert is the task's own expert. No new router evaluation, no rescoring and no model selection was performed.

One-token outputs for VQA (generated_tokens can be 1 to 3) are strongly constrained by near-tied greedy logits: exact match rates are intentionally reported literally and without model-selection interpretation.
Wall/GPU allocation time is reported by SLURM sacct; GPU utilization/utilized capacity is NOT claimed because nvidia-smi utilization was not recorded during the passes.

scheduler.source: sacct --parsable2 when slurmdbd is reachable plus scontrol show job as the slurmctld-side allocation record; both provide allocation wall/cpus/gres only. GPU compute utilization is intentionally not claimed.
scheduler.sacct_note: sacct was captured at merge time; its failure text (if any) is kept in the scheduler evidence log for the cluster DB outage evidence.
